proposed.explanation: The controlling audited source is RA 9514 2019 Revised IRR, Section 10.2.6.6 plus the selected occupancy provisions checked in this batch. The source supports mandatory fire alarm triggers, initiation, notification, fire-department notification, fire-watch handling, and selected assembly, hotel/dormitory, and business occupancy thresholds. Device topology decisions, such as conventional or addressable architecture, need a separate NFPA 72 or PEC engineering source before final publishing if the item turns on that point.
